clues: This town lies in the Cochabamba part of Bolivia. That land sits right in the middle of the country.
This place has a surprising mix of climates for one small town. Valleys, high plains, and warm low lands sit close by, and each one feels different.
Most of this town was once one big farm estate. One rich clan owned it till a huge revolt in nineteen fifty-two.
In twenty ten, crowds came here for a world meet on climate change. They spoke up for the rights of Mother Earth, too.
Locals know this town as the city of flowers. Its farms and dairy herds also make it a busy, well loved place to visit.
